title: Caponata (Sicilian Sweet-and-Sour Aubergine)
summary: Roasted aubergine cubes combined with onion, celery, garlic and peppers, cooked down with tomatoes, then simmered with capers, olives, sugar and cider vinegar until thick and glossy. Best rested overnight.
equipment: large heavy frying pan or sauté pan

ingredients.item: large aubergine (about 700 g), cut into 2 cm cubes
red peppers, cut into 1.5 cm dice
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast the aubergine
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Toss the aubergine with 3 tbsp oil on the lined tray and roast for 25-30 min, turning once, until golden and soft.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp oil in the pan over medium heat and cook the onion and celery for 5 min. Add the garlic for 1 min, then the peppers and half the salt, and cook for 8 min until nearly tender.

steps.title: Add the sweet and sour
steps.text: Add the roasted aubergine, tomatoes and remaining salt and cook for 5-10 min, stirring and scraping, until thickened. Stir in the capers, olives, sugar and vinegar, lower the heat and cook for 20-25 min, stirring often, until thick and glossy. Season with pepper.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cool to room temperature, and if possible chill overnight. Serve at room temperature scattered with basil.

tips: A handful of raisins and toasted pine nuts is a common Palermo addition.
Taste before serving and balance with a little more sugar or vinegar.
Serve on toasted bread as bruschetta.
storage: Refrigerate up to 5 days; the flavour improves after a day. Bring back to room temperature before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
